purpose: R1.17.2 — Event-Relation Audit Durability & Bounded Pending Reads corrections, exactly the TWO second-generation items (A2/D2) and nothing more (no new capability, no Phase-5 scope claim). RED→GREEN evidence: both counterexamples were reproduced RED on the untouched baseline a783058 (A2 {relationCalls:1,rowsDelta:0} — a fault in the relation task's own result path after the provider answered erased the invocation from ai_runs; D2 {pendingBasisRead | pendingEntityProbe ⇒ no deadline race scheduled, the step suspends past expiry}; 3 failed / 20 skipped, exit 1, logs/72-posidon-r1172-red-a783058.log) and are GREEN after the corrections. (A2) The relation service surfaces EVERY REAL attempt at record time — BEFORE the step's own result mapping and BEFORE any observability sink that may itself fail — through a trusted caller collector (EventRelationAttemptObservation: pairId, attemptIndex, canonicalInputHash, attempt); the handler unions the record-time observations with the outcome-mapped rows on every post-provider failure exit (deterministic per-(job,generation,pair,attempt) ids; the fenced standalone insert's own-row guard dedups) so an invocation that happened can never vanish from the audit; zero fabricated rows (the service observes only attempts that actually reached the provider); charges stay (no refund); the retry generation owns its own invocations (no collision, no misattribution, no free lunch). (D2) The entity-probe queries (findStoryCandidatesByEntities) and the basis/reference reads (findDraftForStory, findEditorialSourceItem) are bounded by the SAME absolute step deadline through awaitWithDeadline: expiry frees the caller while the read is still pending (never claimed cancelled), the late settlement is absorbed by the primitive (handlers attached for the promise's whole lifetime — never an unhandled rejection), a deadline observed by a race stops ALL further relation reads (typed basis_unavailable/step_deadline_expired), and the honest unprobed/basis accounting is recorded. A basis whose reference identity was not verified before expiry is NEVER bundled (the bundle pins the reference content hash) — the R1.17.1 slow-basis-read scenario's ledger surface moved from pair-level skipped_deadline to the candidate-level typed technical state with the assertion meaning unchanged (budget consumed, ZERO provider calls, draft commits). The ≤2/≤3 caps, the 15 s step deadline, the separate drafting deadline and the R1.17.1 G1/A1/D1 corrections are untouched; product SQL shapes and gates unchanged.
